803-1168-3510-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1168-3510-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

443-483-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-483-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3995-6006-7008.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3995-6006-7008.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4824-6723-7008.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

333-4247-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4247-7424.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

4985-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

341-4200-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3151-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-7730.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6968-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6968-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6968-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2018-4053-4496.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Accursed Centaur from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7373-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Tellah
1618-2440-7373-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7373-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Tellah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-6972-7155.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

647-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4499-4747-7060.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

511-817-4050-4094-6774.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-6798-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

104-2645-4929-6824.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class and Spider-Man trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
104-2645-4929-6824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1846-4222-4348.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1846-4222-4348.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat from step 2

575-897-2482-3470.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

2793-4064-5129.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{W}{U}{U} available the first turn, with {3}{W}{U} available each extra turn
2793-4064-5129.description:
Activate Abuelo by paying {1}{W}{U}, exiling Ugin's Nexus until the beginning of the next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Abuelo triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
When Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Abuelo by paying {1}{W}{U}, exiling Ugin's Nexus until the beginning of the next end step.
Move to your next turn, not skipping it as Ugin's Nexus is not on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1066-2686-4274.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Borne Upon a Wind by paying {1}{U}, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Barren Glory by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Resolve Barren Glory.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

90-1769-2201-3300.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Meathook Massacre triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3705-4833-5231.description:
Cast Squee, the Immortal by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1003-3249-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {R}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2103-2334-2493.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
